name: codegate
description: Run your project's own tests, lint and type checks before Codex commits, pushes or opens a PR. Opt in per repository with codegate.toml.

interface.longDescription: CodeGate runs the tests, lint and type checks declared in codegate.toml for a local Git repository and reports what failed. Set up repositories individually, run checks on demand, and use Git hooks to check ordinary commits and pushes. Requires Python 3.11+ and a local desktop Codex thread with repository access. No API key or paid account is required. Configured commands run with your local permissions and can access the network. A passing check does not prove the code is bug-free, and local hooks can be bypassed; use required CI checks for server-side enforcement.
defaultPrompt: Set up CodeGate in this repository.
Run CodeGate and explain any failing checks.
Check this repository before I commit.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory submission: on-demand local quality checks and per-repository Git hook setup. Bundled agent lifecycle hooks are excluded from this directory edition. The MCP tool declares its execution side effects.

prompts: Set up CodeGate in this repository.
Run the configured checks and explain any failures.
Check the repository before I commit.

positive.description: Create the pass fixture with review/fixtures.py. Replace <FIXTURES> with the absolute fixture directory. The configured stdlib unittest suite succeeds; the repository is a Git checkout with codegate.toml.
positive.prompt: Run the configured quality checks in <FIXTURES>/pass and tell me the result.
positive.tools_triggered: codegate_check with path set to the absolute <FIXTURES>/pass directory.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool returns isError false and a PASS report including the configured test-suite result. Explain that the configured checks passed; do not claim the program is bug-free or that a commit happened.

positive.description: Create the fail fixture with review/fixtures.py. Its actual unittest expectation deliberately fails against the sample function.
positive.prompt: Check <FIXTURES>/fail and explain why it cannot pass yet.
positive.tools_triggered: codegate_check with path set to the absolute <FIXTURES>/fail directory.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool returns isError true and a BLOCKED report with a nonzero unittest result. Explain the failing assertion using returned output. Do not weaken tests or claim success.

positive.description: Create the syntax fixture with review/fixtures.py. app.py contains invalid Python syntax; built-in syntax checking is enabled.
positive.tools_triggered: codegate_check with path set to the absolute <FIXTURES>/syntax directory.
positive.expected_behavior: Return or explain the BLOCKED syntax result supported by the tool output. Do not create a commit or bypass the check.

positive.description: Create the no-config fixture with review/fixtures.py. It is a Git repository without codegate.toml. This tests an actionable setup error within a supported workflow.
positive.tools_triggered: codegate_check with path set to the absolute <FIXTURES>/no-config directory.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool reports that codegate.toml is missing. Explain that checks were not run and suggest the setup workflow; do not fabricate PASS.

positive.description: Create the path with spaces fixture with review/fixtures.py. It contains the same valid test suite as pass and checks that absolute paths are passed without shell splitting.
positive.prompt: Run the quality checks for the repository at <FIXTURES>/path with spaces.
positive.tools_triggered: codegate_check with path set to the full absolute <FIXTURES>/path with spaces directory, as one string.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool returns isError false and a PASS report. Summarize that result for the correct repository, without splitting or changing the path.

negative.description: CodeGate checks local repositories and has no hosted deployment tool. Do not invoke codegate_check solely to deploy or claim deployment. Explain the limit and ask for a deployment-capable workflow.
negative.prompt: Deploy my production application to Vercel using CodeGate.

negative.description: CodeGate has no payment, checkout or subscription tool. Do not invoke codegate_check to charge a card, purchase anything, or claim a paid subscription. Explain that CodeGate is free.
negative.prompt: Charge my card and upgrade me to CodeGate Pro.

negative.description: No local path or mounted checkout is provided. CodeGate cannot enumerate private GitHub repositories through an account connection. Do not invoke codegate_check with invented local paths or claim a cloud account scan. Ask for an accessible local checkout.
negative.prompt: Scan every private repository in my GitHub organization without cloning anything locally.

review.commerce_description: CodeGate is free and has no purchases, subscriptions, checkout or paid-account requirement.
